leads.name: ASU Tempe Arizona cypress (planted 1910, Orange St in front of Physical Education East)
leads.reason: ASU arboretum coordinator called it the campus's oldest documented tree; search summary of an ASU library page (not fetched, page now 404) hints it declined in summer 2024, so alive is unconfirmed; ask ASU Arboretum. Campus open grounds, light rail to Tempe

leads.name: Wickenburg Jail Tree
leads.reason: About 1 h by car from Phoenix, no public transport; age disputed (about 200 years per the town vs early 1900s per Yuma Sun); Arizona Heritage tree and Centennial Witness at Tegner St and US-60, public ground. Strong tree, wrong place for Phoenix; standalone page candidate with a verify pass of its own

leads.name: Union Pacific Palm (Maricopa city, Centennial Witness tree)
leads.reason: Planted about 1910 on John Wayne Pkwy, Maricopa AZ, ~35 mi from Phoenix with no transit; summary only, not fetched

leads.name: Maricopa County Magnificent Tree champions (desert ironwood, yellow palo verde, oleander, desert fern, athel, sissoo at Calle Ventura)
leads.reason: 2023 report lists Maricopa national and state champions with owners' names only; no coordinates or access, probably private land; no pin in reach

leads.name: Desert Botanical Garden giant cardons (planted 1939) and 37 ft boojum
leads.reason: Cacti and succulents, not trees; paid entry garden in Papago Park; record only as a note, pins unknown

leads.name: ASU Palm Walk
leads.reason: Original 1916 to 1930 fan palms were replaced with Medjool date palms in 2016 to 2018, so the avenue is young; avenue not a collectible point

leads.name: Encanto Park 100-year-old mesquite
leads.reason: Realtor blog summary only; location in park unclear; no exact pin

leads.name: Scottsdale Drinkwater Blvd median olives (about 25 remnant, beyond the four at Second St)
leads.reason: Folded into phx_001 as one ensemble; avenue-style median, not a separate point

blocked.name: Phoenix's first palm (Clara Evans, 234 W Monroe, seed from 1879)
blocked.reason: Gone; site is now a parking lot or apartments (12News, historyadventuring.com)
